mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_shop (shop_name, admin_account, admin_password, logo_url, status) VALUES (#{shopName}, #{adminAccount}, #{adminPassword}, #{logoUrl}, #{status});
mapper.select: select count(1) from tb_shop where shop_name=#{shopName}
select count(1) from tb_shop where admin_account = #{adminAccount}
SELECT id, shop_name AS shopName, admin_account AS adminAccount, admin_password AS adminPassword, logo_url AS logoUrl, status FROM tb_shop WHERE admin_account = #{adminAccount} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_shop SET last_login_time = datetime('now', 'localtime'), login_count = COALESCE(login_count, 0) + 1, updated_at = datetime('now', 'localtime') WHERE id = #{id}
